help.body:
QUICK START
1) Run The Division 2 in English, borderless window, HDR off (Settings → Display & game checks this for you).
2) Pick your ACTIVE BUILD (Panel, Builds or Missing pieces — they share it).
3) Press Start. Hover an item in the game and press F8 (or use Automatic mode in the inventory). The card is found on the whole screen by itself.
4) Verdict: KEEP / CONSIDER / DISMANTLE / CHECK IT, with roll quality and the build slot it fits. Long cards: read the top, scroll, read again — both readings are merged.

PANEL
Verdict, recognized item (name, set/brand, slot, attributes with game max), build matches and a ✔/✖ checklist for the active build's slot. The overlay appears next to the item card in game.

BUILDS
📋 Build sheet: what to farm for every slot (gear-set piece, brand, named/exotic item, core attribute, attributes, chest/backpack talent, weapon type and talent) next to the piece you already have. ✏ Edit: sets/brands, named items, attributes with "good value", talents, weapon types. Meta builds are synced daily.

MISSING PIECES
3D agent (green = owned, red = missing, click a piece), slot cards with requirements and 3D score bars for all builds. Fitting drops are recorded automatically; you are told when a build is complete.

STASH
Every scanned item is saved here; mark the ones you dismantle. Optimize: the best pieces you own for a build (the 4-piece set bonus is kept), fit % per slot and the most valuable next drop. Audit report: what can be dismantled, duplicates, recalibration-library candidates. Vendors: this week's vendors and today's targeted loot matched against your builds; Vendor mode makes F8 read the vendor screen.

COMMUNITY
Opt-in, anonymous drop statistics: pick the activity you play on the Panel and new items count for it. Statistics → Community shows the community size; premium shows what drops where.

PREMIUM
Settings → Premium: enter your license key. Premium adds the recalibration advisor, all builds vs. your stash, CSV export, vendor matches, phone companion and community statistics.

PHONE AND SHARING
Phone companion (Settings → Sync): scan the QR on a phone on the same Wi-Fi. Builds → 🔗 Share turns a build into a code/QR; Paste code adds one.

AI
Panel → Ask the assistant (about the scanned item), Read with Claude (when OCR fails), Read wrong (saves the card and opens a GitHub issue).

TASKS
Shown only in your language, grouped (Journey missions, Manhunt scouts, Classified Assignments, daily/weekly projects). Double-click for details, steps and wiki pictures. 🤖 Fetch with Claude searches the web for the current tasks; the wiki and the shared list sync daily.

ASSISTANT
Chat and voice commands (F9). Uses Ollama, Claude Code, Claude API or OpenAI — choose in the Assistant tab. 🩺 Voice test checks microphone and speech recognition. Start the app with run.bat so the right Python is used.

SETTINGS
General · Effects (cursor, mouse trail, transitions, agent-watch background, header video) · Scanning · Display & game (resolution profile 240p–4K, game settings check, read only) · OCR (engine: RapidOCR recommended or Tesseract; scale, passes, auto calibrate, preview) · Overlay · Sync · Logs.

SAFETY
The app only reads the screen and the game's own settings file. It never reads or writes game memory or files and does not send input to the game.

LANGUAGE
Pick it in Settings → General. To add one, copy lang/en.json, translate the values and save it as lang/<code>.json.

drops.ask:
Help other agents find where gear drops?

If you pick the activity you are playing on the Panel, every NEW item you scan is sent anonymously: item name, slot, rarity and attribute types — never attribute values, your name, e-mail, license key or computer details. No IP address is stored.

You can change this any time in Statistics → Community.
drops.privacy: Only new items count, and only while an activity is selected on the Panel. Sent: item, slot, rarity, attribute types, best roll %, activity and a random ID. Never: values, name, e-mail, license key, computer details; the server stores no IP address.
